SELECT id, plan_code AS planCode, plan_name AS planName, plan_version AS planVersion, price_vnd AS priceVnd, price_xu AS priceXu, price_announced_at AS priceAnnouncedAt, price_effective_at AS priceEffectiveAt, tickets_per_period AS ticketsPerPeriod, period_months AS periodMonths, ticket_validity_days AS ticketValidityDays, status, version FROM reading_subscription_plan ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, plan_code AS planCode, plan_name AS planName, plan_version AS planVersion, price_vnd AS priceVnd, price_xu AS priceXu, price_announced_at AS priceAnnouncedAt, price_effective_at AS priceEffectiveAt, tickets_per_period AS ticketsPerPeriod, period_months AS periodMonths, ticket_validity_days AS ticketValidityDays, status, version FROM reading_subscription_plan WHERE id=#{planId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, plan_code AS planCode, plan_name AS planName, plan_version AS planVersion, price_vnd AS priceVnd, price_xu AS priceXu, price_announced_at AS priceAnnouncedAt, price_effective_at AS priceEffectiveAt, tickets_per_period AS ticketsPerPeriod, period_months AS periodMonths, ticket_validity_days AS ticketValidityDays, status, version FROM reading_subscription_plan WHERE plan_code=#{planCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_subscription_plan (plan_code, plan_name, price_vnd, price_xu, tickets_per_period, period_months, ticket_validity_days, status) VALUES (#{command.planCode}, #{command.planName}, #{command.priceVnd}, #{command.priceXu}, #{command.ticketsPerPeriod}, #{command.periodMonths}, #{command.ticketValidityDays}, 'DRAFT')
mapper.update: UPDATE reading_subscription_plan SET price_announced_at=CASE WHEN NOT (price_vnd <=> #{command.priceVnd}) OR NOT (price_xu <=> #{command.priceXu}) THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE price_announced_at END, price_effective_at=CASE WHEN NOT (price_vnd <=> #{command.priceVnd}) OR NOT (price_xu <=> #{command.priceXu}) THEN DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ELSE price_effective_at END, plan_version=plan_version + CASE WHEN NOT (price_vnd <=> #{command.priceVnd}) OR NOT (price_xu <=> #{command.priceXu}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, plan_name=#{command.planName}, price_vnd=#{command.priceVnd}, price_xu=#{command.priceXu}, tickets_per_period=#{command.ticketsPerPeriod}, period_months=#{command.periodMonths}, ticket_validity_days=#{command.ticketValidityDays}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{planId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status<>'RETIRED' AND plan_code=#{command.planCode}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, plan_id AS planId, plan_code_snapshot AS planCodeSnapshot, plan_version_snapshot AS planVersionSnapshot, price_vnd_snapshot AS priceVndSnapshot, price_xu_snapshot AS priceXuSnapshot, accepted_plan_version AS acceptedPlanVersion, tickets_per_period_snapshot AS ticketsPerPeriodSnapshot, period_months_snapshot AS periodMonthsSnapshot, ticket_validity_days_snapshot AS ticketValidityDaysSnapshot, start_at AS startAt, current_period_start AS currentPeriodStart, current_period_end AS currentPeriodEnd, next_renewal_at AS nextRenewalAt, next_grant_at AS nextGrantAt, end_at AS endAt, status, auto_renew AS autoRenew, primary_funding_source AS primaryFundingSource, fallback_funding_source AS fallbackFundingSource, price_consent_at AS priceConsentAt, cancel_requested_at AS cancelRequestedAt, source_type AS sourceType, source_ref AS sourceRef, policy_version AS policyVersion, version FROM user_reading_subscription WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE', 'PENDING_PRICE_CONSENT', 'CANCEL_AT_PERIOD_END') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, plan_id AS planId, plan_code_snapshot AS planCodeSnapshot, plan_version_snapshot AS planVersionSnapshot, price_vnd_snapshot AS priceVndSnapshot, price_xu_snapshot AS priceXuSnapshot, accepted_plan_version AS acceptedPlanVersion, tickets_per_period_snapshot AS ticketsPerPeriodSnapshot, period_months_snapshot AS periodMonthsSnapshot, ticket_validity_days_snapshot AS ticketValidityDaysSnapshot, start_at AS startAt, current_period_start AS currentPeriodStart, current_period_end AS currentPeriodEnd, next_renewal_at AS nextRenewalAt, next_grant_at AS nextGrantAt, end_at AS endAt, status, auto_renew AS autoRenew, primary_funding_source AS primaryFundingSource, fallback_funding_source AS fallbackFundingSource, price_consent_at AS priceConsentAt, cancel_requested_at AS cancelRequestedAt, source_type AS sourceType, source_ref AS sourceRef, policy_version AS policyVersion, version FROM user_reading_subscription WHERE id=#{subscriptionId} AND user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

mapper.update: UPDATE user_reading_subscription SET auto_renew=#{autoRenew}, primary_funding_source=CASE WHEN #{autoRenew} THEN #{primaryFundingSource} ELSE NULL END, fallback_funding_source=CASE WHEN #{autoRenew} THEN #{fallbackFundingSource} ELSE NULL END, next_renewal_at=CASE WHEN #{autoRenew} THEN current_period_end ELSE NULL END, end_at=CASE WHEN #{autoRenew} THEN NULL ELSE current_period_end END, status=CASE WHEN #{autoRenew} THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'CANCEL_AT_PERIOD_END' END, cancel_requested_at=CASE WHEN #{autoRenew} THEN NULL ELSE #{updatedAt} END, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{subscriptionId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE', 'PENDING_PRICE_CONSENT', 'CANCEL_AT_PERIOD_END')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_subscription_price_consent (subscription_id, user_id, plan_version, price_vnd_snapshot, price_xu_snapshot, consented_at, client_request_id) VALUES (#{subscription.id}, #{subscription.userId}, #{plan.planVersion}, #{plan.priceVnd}, #{plan.priceXu}, #{consentedAt}, #{clientRequestId})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_reading_subscription SET plan_version_snapshot=#{plan.planVersion}, price_vnd_snapshot=#{plan.priceVnd}, price_xu_snapshot=#{plan.priceXu}, accepted_plan_version=#{plan.planVersion}, price_consent_at=#{consentedAt}, status=CASE WHEN auto_renew=1 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE status END, next_renewal_at=CASE WHEN auto_renew=1 THEN current_period_end ELSE NULL END, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{subscriptionId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE', 'PENDING_PRICE_CONSENT', 'CANCEL_AT_PERIOD_END')

UPDATE user_reading_subscription SET auto_renew=0, primary_funding_source=NULL, fallback_funding_source=NULL, next_renewal_at=NULL, end_at=current_period_end, status='CANCEL_AT_PERIOD_END', cancel_requested_at=#{cancelledAt}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{subscriptionId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE', 'PENDING_PRICE_CONSENT', 'CANCEL_AT_PERIOD_END')
mapper.select: SELECT grant_row.id, grant_row.subscription_id AS subscriptionId, grant_row.user_id AS userId, grant_row.period_start AS periodStart, grant_row.period_end AS periodEnd, grant_row.ticket_amount AS ticketAmount, grant_row.ticket_expire_at AS ticketExpireAt, grant_row.create_time AS createTime FROM reading_subscription_period_grant grant_row INNER JOIN user_reading_subscription subscription_row ON subscription_row.id=grant_row.subscription_id AND subscription_row.user_id=#{userId} WHERE grant_row.subscription_id=#{subscriptionId} ORDER BY grant_row.period_start DESC, grant_row.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_reading_subscription (user_id, plan_id, plan_code_snapshot, plan_version_snapshot, price_vnd_snapshot, price_xu_snapshot, accepted_plan_version, tickets_per_period_snapshot, period_months_snapshot, ticket_validity_days_snapshot, start_at, next_grant_at, current_period_start, current_period_end, end_at, status, auto_renew, source_type, source_ref, policy_version) VALUES (#{command.userId}, #{plan.id}, #{plan.planCode}, #{plan.planVersion}, #{plan.priceVnd}, #{plan.priceXu}, #{plan.planVersion}, #{plan.ticketsPerPeriod}, #{plan.periodMonths}, #{plan.ticketValidityDays}, #{command.startAt}, #{command.startAt}, #{command.startAt}, #{command.endAt}, #{command.endAt}, 'ACTIVE', 0, #{command.sourceType}, #{command.sourceRef}, #{command.policyVersion})

INSERT INTO user_reading_subscription (user_id, plan_id, plan_code_snapshot, plan_version_snapshot, price_vnd_snapshot, price_xu_snapshot, accepted_plan_version, tickets_per_period_snapshot, period_months_snapshot, ticket_validity_days_snapshot, start_at, next_grant_at, current_period_start, current_period_end, next_renewal_at, end_at, status, auto_renew, primary_funding_source, fallback_funding_source, source_type, source_ref, policy_version) SELECT #{command.userId}, #{command.planId}, #{command.planCode}, #{command.planVersion}, #{command.priceVnd}, #{command.priceXu}, #{command.acceptedPlanVersion}, #{command.ticketsPerPeriod}, #{command.periodMonths}, #{command.ticketValidityDays}, #{command.startAt}, #{command.startAt}, #{command.startAt}, #{command.endAt}, CASE WHEN #{command.autoRenew} THEN #{command.endAt} ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{command.autoRenew} THEN NULL ELSE #{command.endAt} END, 'ACTIVE', #{command.autoRenew}, #{command.primaryFundingSource}, #{command.fallbackFundingSource}, 'PAYMENT', #{command.sourceRef}, #{command.policyVersion} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_reading_subscription WHERE user_id=#{command.userId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE', 'PENDING_PRICE_CONSENT', 'CANCEL_AT_PERIOD_END') )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, plan_id AS planId, plan_code_snapshot AS planCodeSnapshot, plan_version_snapshot AS planVersionSnapshot, price_vnd_snapshot AS priceVndSnapshot, price_xu_snapshot AS priceXuSnapshot, accepted_plan_version AS acceptedPlanVersion, tickets_per_period_snapshot AS ticketsPerPeriodSnapshot, period_months_snapshot AS periodMonthsSnapshot, ticket_validity_days_snapshot AS ticketValidityDaysSnapshot, start_at AS startAt, current_period_start AS currentPeriodStart, current_period_end AS currentPeriodEnd, next_renewal_at AS nextRenewalAt, next_grant_at AS nextGrantAt, end_at AS endAt, status, auto_renew AS autoRenew, primary_funding_source AS primaryFundingSource, fallback_funding_source AS fallbackFundingSource, price_consent_at AS priceConsentAt, cancel_requested_at AS cancelRequestedAt, source_type AS sourceType, source_ref AS sourceRef, policy_version AS policyVersion, version FROM user_reading_subscription WHERE id=#{subscriptionId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND next_grant_at<=#{now} AND (end_at IS NULL OR next_grant_at<end_at) AND (auto_renew=0 OR current_period_end IS NULL OR next_grant_at<current_period_end) LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_subscription_period_grant (subscription_id, user_id, period_start, period_end, ticket_amount, ticket_expire_at, reading_ticket_ledger_id, idempotency_key, policy_version) SELECT #{subscriptionId}, #{userId}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{ticketAmount}, #{ticketExpireAt}, id, #{idempotencyKey}, policy_version FROM reading_ticket_ledger WHERE idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_reading_subscription SET next_grant_at=#{nextGrantAt}, status=#{nextStatus}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{subscriptionId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE'
